description: Gate Renovate container-scoped automerge behind a path-filtered, always-run ci-container ubuntu job wired as a required status check.

officialDocsConsulted.lib: GitHub Actions / branch protection required status checks
officialDocsConsulted.summary: Confirmed the CAM-178 trap: a required check whose job is skipped by a workflow-level paths filter stays Pending and blocks the PR forever. Successful statuses are success/skipped/neutral. Recommended fix is an always-run job whose heavy steps are conditional on changed paths (not a workflow paths: filter that skips the whole job).

userStories.title: Add always-run, path-filtered ci-container ubuntu job to ci.yml
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need a second CI job that validates the worker container only when container-scoped paths change, so that container-scoped dependency bumps are actually exercised before merge instead of passing blindly on macOS CI.
acceptanceCriteria: A job named 'ci-container' exists in .github/workflows/ci.yml with runs-on: ubuntu-latest, triggered on the same pull_request(branches:[main]) + push(branches:[main]) events as the existing 'ci' job. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'ci-container:' .github/workflows/ci.yml && grep -q 'ubuntu-latest' .github/workflows/ci.yml]

The ci-container job ALWAYS runs (no workflow-level 'paths:' filter that would skip the whole job and wedge the required check as permanently Pending); its first step computes whether any container-scoped path changed vs the base ref using a pin-free bash step (git diff --name-only), where the container-scoped path set is exactly '.devcontainer/**' and '.tool-versions'. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'git diff --name-only' .github/workflows/ci.yml && grep -q '.devcontainer' .github/workflows/ci.yml && grep -q '.tool-versions' .github/workflows/ci.yml]

When no container-scoped path changed, the job neutral-passes fast: it exits 0 without building the image or running the container suite (heavy steps are gated on the changed-paths condition, not the job itself). [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

When a container-scoped path changed, the job builds/ensures the worker image and runs 'bun scripts/test-in-container.ts' (which ensure-ups the cam-worker image, building on cache-miss, and runs bun test via docker exec), failing the job iff the in-container suite reports failures. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'bun scripts/test-in-container.ts' .github/workflows/ci.yml]

The existing 'ci' job stays runs-on: macos-latest with the brew tmux install and the 'bun run check:all' spine unchanged. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'runs-on: macos-latest' .github/workflows/ci.yml]

The ci-parity gate still passes: no non-gate 'bun run <script>' was introduced in the new job (invoke 'bun scripts/test-in-container.ts' directly, or add the script to the check-ci-parity allowlist if using the package.json alias). [oracle: bun run check:ci-parity]

test/ci-workflow.test.ts is updated to assert the new ci-container job/context structure (job name present, ubuntu-latest runner, container-scoped path detection, test-in-container invocation) and continues to pass against the real committed ci.yml. [oracle: bun test test/ci-workflow.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
userStories.notes: Files: .github/workflows/ci.yml (add second job), test/ci-workflow.test.ts (assert new job). GOTCHA (from issue + GitHub docs): a required check skipped by a workflow-level 'paths:' filter stays Pending and blocks the PR forever; use the always-run job + conditional heavy-steps pattern, NEVER a job-level paths filter. GOTCHA: scripts/test-in-container.ts does NOT run 'docker build' itself; it calls the production ensure-container path which builds the cam-worker image on cache-miss (multi-minute) and runs bun test via docker exec. It needs a Docker daemon, present on ubuntu-latest, absent on macos-latest (the CAM-178 trap) which is why the ci job stays macOS and this is a separate ubuntu job. GOTCHA: check-ci-parity (scripts/check-ci-parity.ts) scans every job for 'bun run <script>'; 'bun scripts/test-in-container.ts' and 'bun test' are not 'bun run' invocations so they pass, but 'bun run test:container' (the package.json alias) would need adding to BUN_RUN_ALLOWLIST. Keep the ci job macos-latest (host parity, tmux). .bun-version is deliberately NOT in the container-scoped path set (bun is validated on host CI). Do NOT edit renovate.json.

userStories.title: Require ci-container in branch protection and update the runbook oracle
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need main's required status checks to include both 'ci' and 'ci-container', so that Renovate's existing container-scoped automerge rules wait on the container validation before merging.
acceptanceCriteria: configureBranchProtection (src/release/branch-protection.ts) PUTs required_status_checks.checks containing BOTH { context: 'ci' } and { context: 'ci-container' }, and its GET verification confirms both contexts are present (accepting either the checks[] or the deprecated contexts[] form). [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'ci-container' src/release/branch-protection.ts]

test/release/branch-protection.test.ts is updated so the PUT-body assertion and the verify path cover the two-context required-check set ('ci' and 'ci-container'), including the fallback-warned case when a required context is absent. [oracle: bun test test/release/branch-protection.test.ts]

docs/recovery-runbook.md required-status-checks oracle is updated: the manual-setup steps and the 'gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/main/protection --jq .required_status_checks.checks[].context' verification query document BOTH 'ci' and 'ci-container' (was only 'ci'). [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'ci-container' docs/recovery-runbook.md]

renovate.json is NOT changed: the asdf and dockerfile automerge rules stay automerge:true, now correctly gated because ci-container is a required check that validates container-scoped bumps. [oracle: named-command git diff --exit-code renovate.json]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
userStories.notes: Files: src/release/branch-protection.ts (CI_CHECK_NAME is a single const 'ci'; generalize to a two-context set, update buildProtectionBody + hasCiCheck to require both), test/release/branch-protection.test.ts (fixtures at top: ciInChecks/ciInContexts/ciAbsent responses need a ci-container variant), docs/recovery-runbook.md (branch-protection verify+warn fallback section ~L1630-1665: the manual steps and the --jq contexts query). GOTCHA: Renovate automerge already stays gated on the required CI status check (renovate.json descriptions, ADR 0010); making ci-container a required check is what makes the container-scoped rules wait on it, so renovate.json needs no edit. GOTCHA: the PUT body must keep all four top-level fields (required_status_checks, enforce_admins:false, required_pull_request_reviews:null, restrictions:null) or gh api returns 422. Depends on US-001 (the ci-container job must exist before it is required, else PRs would wedge waiting on a non-existent check).
